scenario.description: Selects the deterministic journey this claim follows, so the run is reproducible.

injuryTypeCode.description: The injury reported at notification, before medical evidence is obtained.

notificationDelayDays.description: Days between the incident and notification of the claim.

liabilityCoverInForce.description: Whether liability cover applies under the policy.

liabilityBasisCode.description: The liability position determined from the evidence gathered. Must be exactly one of the listed values — never a variant spelling and never any other value.

subrogationPotentialFlag.description: True when the evidence points to a third party whose fault could support a subrogation recovery. This is a proposal only — it never decides coverage or whether pursuit is worthwhile.

agentRationale.description: The reasoning behind the liability position, including whether the evidence is ambiguous enough to need an independent medical examination or accident reconstruction. Kept separate from the decision itself; this is what a person reads.
